label: 03 — Principles
heading: AI-assisted engineering,
sub: AI tools are part of how we deliver, not a service we sell. They shorten the path to working, tested and documented software, and four commitments hold on every engagement.

items.title: AI-assisted implementation and exploration
items.desc: AI tools draft code, work through unfamiliar specifications and legacy sources, and try alternatives quickly, so working software arrives sooner and more time goes into your system's edge cases.

items.title: Automated testing and documentation
items.desc: Tests and documentation are produced with the code and kept current as it changes, including test cases derived directly from product and protocol specifications.

items.title: Human review and your sign-off
items.desc: An engineer reviews every change and is accountable for it. Nothing is delivered until you have signed it off.

items.title: You own the result
items.desc: Source code, tests, architecture documentation and runbooks are yours and transferable. Another team can take over without us.
